adjudication.rationale: The diff adds `EmbedController#ensure_embeddable`, which rejects requests when `URI(request.referer || '').host != SiteSetting.embeddable_host` and rescues `URI::InvalidURIError` to raise invalid access. In `spec/controllers/embed_controller_spec.rb`, referer handling is only covered for (a) no referer ("raises an error with no referer") and (b) a successful path where `controller.request.stubs(:referer).returns(embed_url)` matches the configured host. There is no test for a referer from a different host nor for an unparseable referer that would trigger the rescue path, so regressions in host comparison/parsing wouldn’t be caught by this spec.
